newsitem.title: EGYPT: Arafat in Cairo for Mideast talks with Mubarak.
newsitem.headline: Arafat in Cairo for Mideast talks with Mubarak.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat arrived on Monday for talks with President Hosni Mubarak while controversy raged in Israel over plans for another Jewish neighbourhood in Arab East Jerusalem, airport officials said.
Egypt regards itself as an unofficial sponsor of the peace process and Arafat regularly consults Mubarak on negotiations with Israel.
The Palestinians say Arab East Jerusalem is the capital of their future state while Israel argues that the whole city is its capital.
Israeli officials had plans for apartment blocks in Har Homa but opposition members said building on the site would reignite Arab-Israeli violence.
Both Egypt and Arafat have slammed the settlement expansion policy of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, saying it is the biggest obstacle to peace.
